about_the_game:
Note: This visual novel essentially serves as an additional epilogue episode to its predecessor SHINRAI - Broken Beyond Despair. As such, it is strongly recommended to experience the original SHINRAI first in order to avoid spoilers for it and to be able to fully understand Saku.

Story:

Thursday, December 2, 2010. 

One month after that dreadful Halloween night, Raiko’s school grade travels to the city of Tenrinto. While many of the students are excited, planning to make the most of the long-awaited trip, some are still affected by the tragic events they have been through and continue to struggle with their aftermath. Life goes on, however.

And whether it’s by reverting back to their old shenanigans to blend out the problems, or by confronting them head-on, everyone needs to find a way to move along… lest they be left behind to wither away.

What To Expect:

SHINRAI Saku is not a murder mystery. While there will be some moments that do require Raiko to once again use her deductive skills, the story primarily focuses on the challenges and problems that she and her classmates are facing following the events of October 30, and how they are dealing with them.

Consequently, there won't be any interactive gameplay elements this time around, such as choices, investigation segments or evidence presentation. Instead, this is an entirely kinetic experience, making it a visual novel in the truest sense of the term. 

Features:

  • Notebook containing character profiles, diary entries & various setting-related trivia bits.

  • Unlockable Extras

  • Original Soundtrack

  • ~40,000+ words in length.

content_descriptors.notes: While not a murder mystery itself, SHINRAI Saku deals with the aftermath of the murders from the original SHINRAI. Consequently, some darker topics relating to death and murder are discussed.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: 7
  • Processor: 1Ghz
  • Memory: 512 MB RAM
  • Storage: 500 MB available space

short_description: A month has passed since the tragic events at the Miyamoto Mountain Resort, which still weigh heavily on Raiko and her friends. Explore the challenges they face while trying to return to an ordinary life in this follow-up to the visual novel SHINRAI - Broken Beyond Despair.
